A month of payroll

What we do, day by day

An example February for an employer who pays every second Friday and remits to the CRA each month.

Example month · February · not a real year
SunMonTueWedThuFriSat
123 Pay4
567891011
12131415 CRA1617 Pay18
19202122232425
262728 T4
  1. 3 and 17 · Pay day We run the pay and deduct CPP, EI and income tax.
  2. 15 · CRA remittance due We send January's source deductions to the CRA. A regular remitter pays by the 15th of the next month.
  3. 28 · T4 deadline We file last year's T4 return. Your employees get their T4 slips by the last day of February.
  4. All month Your dedicated bookkeeper enters each pay run in your books.

Your remittance schedule can differ. The CRA sets it by the amount you withhold. If a due date falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the due date is the next business day. Source: Canada Revenue Agency, canada.ca.

Common questions

Bookkeeping and payroll FAQ

What does outsourced payroll cost in Winnipeg?

Payroll on its own starts at $99/month. Our Bookkeeping plan at $299/month includes payroll for up to 3 employees. The Bookkeeping & Tax plan at $499/month includes payroll for up to 10 employees.

Can one firm do my bookkeeping and payroll together?

Yes. Your dedicated bookkeeper runs both, so payroll entries, remittances and your books always match. You deal with one team instead of two.

What do your payroll services include?

Payroll processing, source deduction remittances to CRA, T4 slips, Records of Employment (ROEs) and year-end payroll reconciliation.

Can I switch payroll providers in the middle of the year?

Yes. On the free call Jennifer walks you through the steps for your business, so the change fits between two paydays.

Do you handle CRA communication about payroll?

Yes. We handle CRA communication for our clients. We have helped with more than 100 CRA audits.

Where are your bookkeepers located?

All our bookkeepers are in-house and located in Manitoba, near Winnipeg. Each client has one dedicated bookkeeper.
